description: Canonical MOIL site AOIs and mine list. THE single definition of where the three sites are. Every consumer (geo_utils, generate_datasets, seed_dev, the GEE and prospectivity pipelines, the frontend) reads this file -- directly or via a generated copy kept byte-identical by scripts/build_site_aois.py.
buffer_note: Each site bbox is the bounding box of its included mines, expanded by buffer_km on all four sides. Degrees-per-km: 110.574 for latitude, 111.320 * cos(mid-latitude) for longitude, so the buffer is buffer_km on both axes, not buffer_km-of-degrees.
coordinate_provenance: Mine coordinates come from the site-AOI verification report dated 2026-09-23, which sourced them from OpenStreetMap quarry/village features and supporting documents; the `source` field on each mine records what that report said about it. Five of the ten (Munsar, Chikla, Dongri Buzurg, Kandri, Gumgaon) were independently cross-checked against Google Maps on 2026-09-23: four matched within 1.5 km, Gumgaon was off by ~6.9 km and its coordinates were replaced with the cross-checked value.

sites.name: Balaghat
sites.centre_reverse_geocode: Paraswada Tahsil, Balaghat, Madhya Pradesh (boundary/administrative, rural) -- Nominatim, 2026-09-23

mines.source: Village centroid; unnamed quarries mapped at 21.948-21.980 N / 80.432-80.475 E
mines.note: Coordinates are the village, not the pit. The 5 km buffer covers the mapped quarry cluster.

mines.note: EXCLUDED from the bbox until the pit location is confirmed. Including it would grow this AOI from ~142 km2 to ~580 km2 for one low-confidence point. It still renders on the MOIL mines point layer as a provisional marker.

mines.source: Verification report 2026-09-23; cross-checked against Google Maps (match within 1.5 km)

unassigned_mines.name: Tirodi
unassigned_mines.note: EXCLUDED for now, by decision of 2026-09-23. Administratively in Balaghat district (MP) but ~55 km west of Bharveli and geologically in the Sausar belt; folding it into the balaghat AOI would make that box 3617 km2 and overlap the bhandara box in longitude, which silently breaks assign_site_id. Promote it to a 4th site rather than merging it. Renders on the MOIL mines point layer as a provisional marker.
